### Module dirs in this anchored hub (LoomYard #38)

The code anchor is `dotnet/`, and lym resolves a module's `dir` against different bases.
`gate.yaml` tiers join `dir` onto the worktree root, so they keep `dir: dotnet`.
`drift.yaml` capture and compare join `dir` onto the anchor, so they keep `dir: .`.
Keep both until #38 is fixed, then remove this rule.
